theorems.statement: ∀ (n k : ℕ), 0 < n → ∃ θ₀ δ₂ : ℝ, 0 < θ₀ ∧ θ₀ ≤ 1 / 4 ∧ 0 < δ₂ ∧ δ₂ ≤ 1 / 8 ∧ ∀ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ → δ ≤ δ₂ → ∀ (U W : Set (Euclid (n + k))) (R : IMRep U n) (H : Euclid (n + k) → Euclid (n + k)) (κ ρ : ℝ) (z : Euclid (n + k)), IsOpen W → W ⊆ U → 0 < ρ → closedBall z ρ ⊆ W → AEStronglyMeasurable H R.measure → (∀ x, ‖H x‖ ≤ κ) → (∀ X : Euclid (n + k) → Euclid (n + k), ContDiff ℝ 1 X → HasCompactSupport X → tsupport X ⊆ W → R.firstVariation X = -∫ x, inner ℝ (X x) (H x) ∂R.measure) → z ∈ R.measure.support → R.measure (closedBall z ρ) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (1 + δ) * unitBallVolume n * ENNReal.ofReal (ρ ^ n) → κ * ρ ≤ δ → ∀ ξ ∈ R.measure.support ∩ closedBall z (δ * ρ), ∀ (σ : ℝ) (T : Submodule ℝ (Euclid (n + k))), 0 < σ → σ ≤ δ * ρ → Module.finrank ℝ T = n → ∃ S : Submodule ℝ (Euclid (n + k)), Module.finrank ℝ S = n ∧ max (ENNReal.ofReal (1 / (θ₀ * σ) ^ n) * ∫⁻ x in closedBall ξ (θ₀ * σ), ENNReal.ofReal (∑ i : Fin (n + k), ‖(approxTangentPlane n R.carrier x).starProjection (EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ)) - S.starProjection (EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ))‖ ^ 2) ∂R.measure) (ENNReal.ofReal (κ ^ 2 * (θ₀ * σ) ^ 2 / δ)) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal θ₀ * max (ENNReal.ofReal (1 / σ ^ n) * ∫⁻ x in closedBall ξ σ, ENNReal.ofReal (∑ i : Fin (n + k), ‖(approxTangentPlane n R.carrier x).starProjection (EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ)) - T.starProjection (EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ))‖ ^ 2) ∂R.measure) (ENNReal.ofReal (κ ^ 2 * σ ^ 2 / δ))
